FN-2JV4QSK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 104
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Economic Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 104 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Examiners of
Public Accounts (EPA) by a small, undetermined amount to provide a board governance course
to all board members of boards subject to the Alabama Sunset Law.
In addition, this bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Office of the
Attorney General to determine the course curriculum for the course, in consultation with the
EPA, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
